title: Docker Container Name References & Deploy Workflow

what_happened.task: Deploying Moralis API migration and phantom position fixes to VPS

what_went_well: Moralis deprecated endpoint migration was clean — 3 endpoints migrated, 0 test failures
Phantom position auto-close logic correctly detects zero-balance positions
Reviewer script correctly validates container state, logs, and git sync
what_went_wrong: Used wrong docker command format — `docker logs shamrock-bot` failed because after docker compose down/up, container names can shift. Must use `docker compose logs bot` (service name) not `docker logs shamrock-bot` (container name)
Deploy workflow was inconsistent — sometimes `docker compose down` then `docker compose up -d`, sometimes `docker compose down && docker rm -f ...`, causing container name conflicts
Phantom auto-close doesn't persist — positions reload from storage every monitor cycle, so auto-close fires infinitely
key_insights.root_cause: Docker Compose service names (bot, dashboard, db, health) vs container names (shamrock-bot, shamrock-dashboard, shamrock-db, shamrock-health) confusion. Also position persistence layer not consulted during auto-close.

patterns_extracted.rule: Always use `docker compose logs <service>` (service name from docker-compose.yml) not `docker logs <container-name>`. Service names: bot, dashboard, db, health, paper-trader. Container names: shamrock-bot, shamrock-dashboard, shamrock-db, shamrock-health, shamrock-paper.

Deploy to VPS must follow the workflow in .agents/workflows/sync-and-deploy.md. The canonical sequence is: git pull → docker compose down → docker compose up -d --build. Never mix `docker rm -f` with compose orchestration. If containers linger, use `docker compose down --remove-orphans` not manual rm.

Moralis deprecated GET /discovery/tokens/top-gainers, top-losers, and buying-pressure on June 4, 2026. Replacement: POST /discovery/tokens with sortBy and filters. Always check Moralis changelog before assuming endpoint paths are stable.

When auto-closing phantom positions (zero on-chain balance), must also persist the closure to the position storage layer — not just set remaining_quantity=0 in the dict. Otherwise positions reload from disk/DB every monitor cycle and trigger infinite auto-close spam.

Before claiming a chain is 'production ready', verify: 1) RPC URL is set and valid (not dummy), 2) Block explorer API key is real (not 'dummy'), 3) Wallets are funded on that chain, 4) MODE=live in .env. BASESCAN_API_KEY=dummy and ARBISCAN_API_KEY=dummy mean safety checks are degraded.

user_feedback.comments: User called out repeatedly using wrong container name format. 'remember the container name. you do the wrong name consistently'
